text:
maria (PM): Kicking off discussion for 'Elastic Cushion' - a small SLA-backed reserved cushion for committed customers that smooths short spikes without large idle clusters. Need launch criteria, billing model, and ops guardrails.

igor (Eng): Love the name :) Two quick asks: how do we measure exhaustion (requests/sec vs minutes)? and what's the expected p99 improvement?

maria (PM): Proposal: cushion = min(10% of committed concurrency, 25 minutes of peak). Goal: p95 at baseline and p99 improve by at least 30% during 5-15m spikes.

reena (Infra): Implementation approach: CushionManager service tracks per-reservation token-buckets and hands out fast lanes. Keep small pinned KV shards while cushion active. Avoid fully idle GPUs.

lee (SRE): Runbook needs: deterministic fallback plan, canary steps, rollback triggers. Suggest triggers: p99 > 500ms for 5m OR error-rate delta +1% sustained 5m.

sam (Finance): Billing options: 1) flat cushion uplift on reservation (predictable), 2) metered consumption when cushion used. Recommend hybrid: small monthly uplift + per-minute metered overage. Will model.

anya (Legal): Customers will want a clear SLA section: define "cushion exhaustion", list failover behaviors, explicit credit calculation, and opt-in for cross-region spill. Also check logging/data residency for private installs.

igor (Eng): Notes on fallback: prefer fallback to a quantized model variant first, then region spill. Routing policy: reserved -> cushion -> quantized_variant -> spill_region. Need hooks in smart-routing.

reena (Infra): Soft-eviction plan: mark pinned KV shards reclaimable but keep LRU grace for 3 minutes to prevent thundering warmups. Also keep a tiny warmpool per-tenant if cushion active.

lee (SRE): Monitoring: emit cushion_usage, cushion_remaining_minutes, cushion_failover_count, and cushion_failover_latency. Alerts: usage>70% for 30m (notify capacity); >95% (page oncall + recommend contact).

maria (PM): Draft launch acceptance criteria:
- SLO: under committed baseline + cushion usage, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 350ms.
- Failover: when cushion exhausted, fallback latency added < 500ms for 99% of requests.
- Observability: per-tenant metrics and daily digest available in Console.
- Billing: default includes small cushion uplift; customers can opt into metered overage.
- Safety: automatic rollback if rollback triggers fired (see SRE triggers).

igor (Eng): config sketch for ops/devs:
```
elastic_cushion:
  allocation_mode: percent | token
  percent: 10
  token_minutes: 25
  fallback_order: quantized_model, spill_region
  billing: uplift_plus_overage | uplift_only
  rollback_triggers:
    p99_ms: 500
    error_rate_delta_pct: 1
```

reena (Infra): Dependencies: metric ingestion for per-tenant cushion metrics and routing hook in smart-router. Filing tickets after this thread.

sam (Finance): Will post modeled ARPU impact and recommend uplift % by EOD tomorrow. Pilot customers must sign an addendum covering cushion terms.

anya (Legal): I'll draft SLA language and a pilot contract addendum. Cross-region spill requires explicit customer consent.

devex (DevEx): We'll need docs showing how to tune for cushion (batch sizes, model variants) and a customer-facing dashboard mock.

lee (SRE): Pilot plan suggestion: 2-3 customers, staged rollout over 72h, internal chaos test first (force token exhaustion). Hard pilot cap of 3 customers to limit blast radius.

maria (PM): Proposed timeline:
- Week 0: finalize design, pricing approach, SLA draft
- Week 1-3: engineering (CushionManager + routing + metrics)
- Week 4: internal canary + chaos tests
- Week 5: pilot with up to 3 customers (contract addendum)
- Week 6: evaluate pilot, GA if green

reena (Infra): I'll open INFRA ticket for metrics ingestion and prototype soft-eviction behavior.

igor (Eng): I'll produce a 1-pager spec for CushionManager and post to product-docs by EOD Wed.

lee (SRE): I'll draft the canary checklist and escalation playbook.

sam (Finance): Posting preliminary pricing model tomorrow.

anya (Legal): Draft SLA and pilot addendum in progress.

maria (PM): Great — next sync scheduled Thu 30m. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for launch decisions. :thumbsup:
